blockers.detail: Local private quarantine upload/attachment passed desktop/mobile Chrome. Clean retrieval, real ClamAV/bounded decoding and isolated OCR have not passed provider acceptance.

Approved migrations 020/021 and six real PostgreSQL scenarios pass with injected provider responses. Real Stripe test Checkout, Portal, signed webhook delivery and lifecycle verification require credentials.
Nodemailer TLS loopback SMTP verification/recovery/team delivery passed. Approved production SMTP sender/TLS/service and delivery monitoring are absent.

Contact adapter is wired to approved 004 schema behind dedicated runtime/bot configuration. Real Turnstile, dedicated credential, SMTP contact outbox worker and browser submission acceptance remain incomplete. Leads require separate managed service configuration.
Dashboard/audit/documents/company/team/billing are connected. Support ticket backend, administrator management, some detail/POS routes and complete financial report coverage remain incomplete.

SaaS runtimes deliberately accept only isolated 55440/3444. Managed database/storage/worker configuration, least-privilege secrets, monitoring/alerts, scheduling and a separately approved fresh-target restore drill are required.
ORS/banking accepted previously; onboarding/team/local upload/SMTP browser tests pass. Full clean-document/OCR/provider billing and recovery acceptance remain blocked. No deployment authorization.
